source_semantics.confirmation: The authoritative control requires _confirmation.Trim() == CLEANUP and a positive removable preview before cleanup.
source_semantics.browser_cancel_boundary: RunCleanupAsync invokes a browser confirm dialog and performs no cleanup if the user cancels or confirmation cannot be opened.
source_semantics.mutation: Maintenance.CleanupAsync removes eligible operation-history rows according to the selected retention policy.
source_semantics.truthful_success: The source rereads Maintenance.GetSnapshotAsync after the mutation before presenting final visible state.

runtime_path: route tenant slug equality against active TenantContext
authenticated actor ID equality against active membership user_id
transactional tenant-scoped cleanup with bounded DB retry
redirect success only after persisted counts reconcile

authentication_authorization.active_tenant: ResolveTenantContext establishes the active tenant only from an authenticated active membership.
authentication_authorization.direct_id_surface: No site/history/tenant/actor ID is accepted as a route parameter or trusted request field.

tenant_and_identity_ownership.model_scope: SiteOperationHistory extends DomainModel, whose BelongsToTenant concern applies TenantScope to reads/deletes and server-assigns tenant_id on creation.
tenant_and_identity_ownership.actor_identity: The controller derives the authenticated user ID from request->user() and verifies it equals TenantContext membership.user_id; caller actor_user_id is ignored.
tenant_and_identity_ownership.caller_tenant_identity: The controller uses TenantContext tenant slug and never consumes caller tenant_id.
tenant_and_identity_ownership.foreign_row_proof: Focused acceptance seeds Alpha and Beta histories and proves Alpha cleanup removes only Alpha rows while Beta rows remain unchanged.

validation_and_confirmation.confirmation: trimmed value must equal exact uppercase CLEANUP
validation_and_confirmation.browser_confirmation: The rendered form adds a window.confirm cancellation boundary before submission.

csrf.exceptions: bootstrap/app.php excludes only api/v1/billing/webhooks/paypal; this cleanup route is not exempt.

persistence_and_truthfulness.transaction: SiteOperationHistoryService::cleanup executes inside DB::transaction with 3 bounded retry attempts.
persistence_and_truthfulness.precondition: A real tenant-scoped preview must report at least one removable row.
persistence_and_truthfulness.mutation_result: The service returns real removed_count and remaining_count from the database.
persistence_and_truthfulness.authoritative_reread: The controller rereads tenant-scoped storage and preview after cleanup.
persistence_and_truthfulness.success_gate: Success is emitted only when after-count equals service remaining_count, equals before-count minus removed_count, and reread preview total_count equals after-count.

idempotency_retry_cancellation.retry: The database transaction uses a bounded retry count of 3 for transactional failures.
idempotency_retry_cancellation.replay: After a successful cleanup with no further eligible rows, the same request returns 409 and performs no additional mutation.
idempotency_retry_cancellation.cancellation: User cancellation exists before submission through browser confirmation; no asynchronous cancellation is fabricated after the synchronous transaction begins.

secret_and_external_boundaries.secret_non_exposure: The form/controller contain no password, API key, client secret, provider secret or credential fields; malicious extra secret input is ignored and not echoed.
secret_and_external_boundaries.wordpress_connector: No WordPress or Connector call is performed.
secret_and_external_boundaries.payment_provider: No billing/payment provider call is performed despite the canonical scanner domain/dependency classification.
secret_and_external_boundaries.queue_cache_scheduler: No queue, cache or scheduler side effect is introduced.

terminality.basis: The critical cleanup control now reaches a real Laravel destructive runtime that is authenticated, tenant-scoped, permission-gated, CSRF-protected, allow-list validated, confirmation-gated, transactionally persisted, foreign-tenant safe, replay fail-closed, secret-free, and truthful only after authoritative reread.
